QUEUE_ADMISSION.evidence: consumer/main_test.go records PlaybackStats.QueuedSamples before registry.Advance; exact 480-sample frame admitted.

BUFFER_RECEIPT.evidence: RTCDeviceSink.writeAdmittedPlaybackLocked is the runtime receipt after device queue write and before the callback.

FILE_OR_SOFTWARE_RECEIPT.evidence: C51 consumer intentionally exercises the runtime device service rather than the separate file output role; no file sink result is relabeled as device consumption.

SOFTWARE_DEVICE_CALLBACK_CONSUMPTION.evidence: SimulatedDuplexRegistry.Advance -> PlaybackQueue.RenderInto records one render trace with QueueBefore=480, QueueAfter=0, RenderedSamples=480 and exact PCM order.

PHYSICAL_HARDWARE_CONSUMPTION.evidence: The admitted user-windows-hardware-scope-20260910 amendment excludes native Windows endpoints and physical acoustic testing; C51 retains software/compile/hermetic validation and makes no PASS claim.
